task_description: Write the full 9-book Korean-language light novel series 'Omelasian Bible' (오멜라스 성서) into the omelas repo, plus Korean translations of the existing English canon files. All prose in Korean. Total length target: the whole series ~250 pages combined (~27-28 pages per book, using ~450 Korean characters/page => ~110,000-125,000 characters total). Anchored to the in-repo canon (README.md, ideation.md, page-1.md) and an authoritative Korean story bible. Do not push or open PRs.
